def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Find the uniform separator and split into the two aligned patterns.
    sep = next((r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1), None)
    if sep is not None:
        a, b = grid[:sep], grid[sep + 1:]
    else:
        sep = next(c for c in range(w)
                   if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1)
        a = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
        b = [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]

    colors_a = set(x for row in a for x in row)
    colors_b = set(x for row in b for x in row)
    common = colors_a & colors_b
    background = next(iter(common))

    mark_a = next(x for x in colors_a if x != background)
    mark_b = next(x for x in colors_b if x != background)

    rows, cols = min(len(a), len(b)), min(len(a[0]), len(b[0]))
    return [[3 if a[r][c] == mark_a and b[r][c] == mark_b else background
             for c in range(cols)] for r in range(rows)]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    sep_row = next((r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1), None)
    if sep_row is not None:
        a, b = grid[:sep_row], grid[sep_row + 1:]
    else:
        sep_col = next(c for c in range(w)
                       if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1)
        a = [row[:sep_col] for row in grid]
        b = [row[sep_col + 1:] for row in grid]

    common = set(x for row in a for x in row) & set(x for row in b for x in row)
    color = next(iter(common))
    rows = min(len(a), len(b))
    cols = min(len(a[0]), len(b[0]))

    return [[3 if a[r][c] == color and b[r][c] == color else color
             for c in range(cols)] for r in range(rows)]
